data.name: Click the Cubes
data.detailed_description:
Click. Destroy. Build. Repeat.

A clicker game where no cube survives. Smash your way through levels built from colorful cube shapes, from ducks and hotdogs to all kinds of strange creations, clearing each one as fast as possible. Earn upgrades, unlock powerful abilities, and turn your humble clicks into a cube-destroying machine. Then jump into the built-in level editor to create your own challenges and share them with players around the world. Humanity spent centuries building civilization, and somehow we ended up optimizing the destruction of geometric snacks.

Features:

  • Simple, satisfying gameplay: Click, destroy, and clear every cube in sight.

  • Creative levels: Blast through a growing collection of fun and recognizable cube-built shapes.

  • Upgrade system: Unlock upgrades that boost your clicking power, increase your speed, and help you demolish levels even faster.

  • Power-ups and abilities: Discover special power-ups that unleash extra destruction and wipe out huge groups of cubes.

  • Built-in level editor: Design your own cube creations from scratch with an easy-to-use editor.

  • Steam Workshop support: Upload your levels, download creations from other players, and keep the chaos going with endless community content.

  • Leaderboards: Compete for the fastest completion times and prove that your cube-clicking reflexes are superior to everyone else's. A surprisingly prestigious title in the grand hierarchy of human achievement.

  • Fast arcade-style pacing: Perfect for quick sessions or longer cube-crushing marathons.
